hinge.title: When a hammered sample flattens, breaks, or does neither, decide whether it is malleable, brittle, or neither.
node_labels: Matter: materials, particles, mixtures and change

mx.teacher_note: Copper is neither malleable nor brittle.

intelligence.enrichment: Copper, iron, and aluminium flatten into sheets when beaten; this flattening property is malleability. Coal and sulfur break into pieces and are brittle, while wood neither flattens into a sheet nor breaks into pieces in this comparison. The result of hammering determines whether the material shows malleability, brittleness, or neither behavior. The learner correctly applies this rule: Copper, iron, and aluminium flatten into sheets when beaten; this flattening property is malleability. Coal and sulfur break into pieces and are brittle, while wood neither flattens into a sheet nor breaks into pieces in this comparison. Hammered materials have only two outcomes: metals flatten and everything else is brittle.
